name: Hermes Agent (persistent config volume)
description: Nous Research Hermes Agent installed into the image at build time, with only its config, keys, memories and sessions kept in a named volume shared by every dev container.

version.description: 'latest' installs the HEAD of main (alias of 'main'); any other branch name works the same. A commit SHA (7-40 hex) installs that commit detached, so 'hermes update' leaves it alone. The installed commit is recorded in /usr/local/share/hermes-agent/version.

browser.description: Install the browser tools (agent-browser + Chromium). Off passes --skip-browser.

computerUse.description: Install the computer-use driver (cua-driver). Off passes --skip-computer-use.

installDir.description: Code checkout (installer --dir). Lives in the image and is refreshed on every rebuild.

runtimeDir.description: Tool store (HERMES_RUNTIME_DIR: uv, node, ripgrep, ...). Lives in the image.

installsDir.description: Dependency state (the venv Hermes would keep in HERMES_HOME/installs/<key>). Lives in the image; HERMES_HOME/installs/<key> links to it. Must be outside homeDir.

homeDir.description: Data dir (HERMES_HOME: config.yaml, .env, memories, sessions). The hermes-agent-config volume is always mounted at /var/lib/hermes; for another path, add your own mount.

linkUserHome.description: Symlink ~/.hermes to homeDir when ~/.hermes does not exist yet.
